digest.component_or_area: LLM provider session and factory pattern
propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inlined in runner.py:268 with a hardcoded branch for Anthropic, forcing each new provider to add another branch rather than registering with a central builder
Client lifecycle (httpx.AsyncClient) has no ownership model; the retrying client is returned as a tuple element and manually closed in a finally block, creating a teardown coupling that scales poorly
A ProviderSession object should own the provider factory lifecycle, maintain a registry mapping provider names to builders, and collect closeables for unified teardown via context manager
The Anthropic builder must construct clients with unchanged tenacity transport, max_retries=0 guard, and loopback-proxy bypass, then register the client with the session and return only the provider
Two existing tests import _build_retrying_anthropic_model from runner but must be updated to import from anthropic_model after the relocation
The model_override code path must continue to bypass the factory and construct no client, as a negative control and to preserve existing behavior
